headlessFlag.note: The run subcommand is the non-interactive mode; plain opencode starts the TUI.

effortFlag.note: The variant names are provider-specific reasoning effort levels.

permissionDefault.note: Most permissions allow by default; doom_loop and external_directory ask, and .env files are not readable.

instructionFiles.note: CLAUDE.md files are fallbacks used only when no AGENTS.md exists in that category.

evidence.locator: Claude Code Compatibility; Precedence; Custom Instructions

subagents.note: Built-in subagents are general, explore, and scout; custom ones come from opencode.json or agents/*.md files.

guidance.text: Use opencode run with a message for scripted work. Pass --format json for raw events, and --attach to a running opencode serve to skip MCP cold starts.
Permissions start mostly on allow, so a run can edit and execute freely. Add deny rules in the permission config to restrict it; the last matching rule wins.
--auto approves every request that would otherwise ask, but explicit deny rules still block. It works with opencode run.
Set reasoning effort with --variant. The accepted names are provider-specific, for example high or max for Anthropic and none through xhigh for OpenAI.
OpenCode falls back to CLAUDE.md, ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, and ~/.claude/skills/ when AGENTS.md is absent. Set OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE=1 to turn that off.
Name a model as provider/model with -m; opencode models lists the valid identifiers, and --refresh updates the list from models.dev.
